newsitem.title: USA: Angel commemorating slain South Carolina boys stolen.
newsitem.headline: Angel commemorating slain South Carolina boys stolen.

text.p: Thieves have stolen a small angel figure that stood atop a monument to the two South Carolina boys drowned in a lake by their mother two years ago, police said on Monday.
The angel, which glowed red at night, sat on a granite monument donated by Paula Richburg, a Lexington bank employee touched by the deaths of Michael and Alex Smith.
The lake has become something of a shrine, with scores of visitors flocking to see where the boys died and visiting the monuments just up the hill from the shore.

Susan Smith is serving a life sentence for their murders. She claimed a carjacker took her children but nine days later confessed to letting her car roll down the boat ramp at John D. Long Lake with the boys still strapped inside.

Richburg told the Spartanburg Herald-Journal on Sunday: "Michael and Alex have lost their lives, now someone is trying to steal the memorial to honour them. I hope when this person goes to sleep at night, he sees their two faces."
